jobs.description:
About the Role
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key Responsibilities
• Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq.
• Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design.
• Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency.
• Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team.
Requirements & Qualifications
• Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects.
• Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts.
• Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory).
• Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects.
• Language Skills:
• Fluent English (written and spoken).
• Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration).
• Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams.

jobs.occupation: Finance Officer – Financial Control, Reporting & Process Improvement
jobs.description:
As a Finance Officer, you join the Administration Division of an international intergovernmental organisation promoting free trade and economic integration. You take hands-on responsibility for financial control and reporting while leading initiatives to improve administrative and financial processes.
 

You report directly to the Head of Finance and work within a four-person finance team. The department manages the organisation’s finances across offices in Brussels, Luxembourg and Geneva, as well as its Financial Mechanism Office.
 

This position is exclusively open to nationals of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. The starting date is as soon as possible and no later than 1 March 2027. The application deadline is 18 October 2026.
 

Je verantwoordelijkheden:
 
 

• Preparing financial reports and analyses. 

• Performing accounting controls. 

• Coordinating the year-end closing process. 

• Managing projects to improve business processes within the Administration Division. 

• Overseeing procurement activities. 

• Overseeing contract management. 

• Overseeing travel management. 

• Acting as Head of Finance when required. 
 

• Nationality of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland is an essential eligibility requirement. 

• A master’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting or another relevant field is required. 

• At least five years of relevant experience in financial management, accounting, controlling, audit and/or consulting provides the necessary professional foundation. 

• A solid understanding of accounting, controlling and reporting is essential. 

• Practical experience with at least one accounting software package is required. 

• Excellent command of MS Excel supports your daily work. 

• Fluency in written and spoken English is essential. 

• A structured and analytical mindset characterises your approach. 

• Strong interpersonal skills allow you to collaborate effectively with colleagues. 

• You demonstrate commitment, motivation and initiative. 

• At least two years of consulting experience is an advantage. 

• Experience with payroll and public procurement would be an asset. 

• Knowledge of MS Dynamics 365 Finance and Power BI, including Power Query and Power Pivot, offers added value. 

• Experience as an IT systems superuser and/or with systems implementation is an advantage. 

• Project management experience and the ability to lead business improvement processes are valuable. 

• Previous work in an international environment is a plus. 

• Self-reliance, autonomy and a proactive approach complete your profile.

Are you ready to shape the future of defense systems? Located in Liège, this opportunity offers a chance to lead groundbreaking advancements in system engineering. Promote simulation tools, digital twins, automated testing, and continuous integration tailored to high-stakes environments.

• Technological Partnerships: Drive strategic partnerships in areas such as sensors, counter-UAS systems, autonomy software, and more. Integrate external components seamlessly without compromising system integrity.

To excel in this role as Head of Systems Engineering - Robotics you should bring:

• Experience:
• 15+ years in engineering complex systems.
• Background in performance robotics (e.g., military/security robotics, drones/autonomous systems, critical industrial robotics).
• Proven track record in hardware/software integration, multi-disciplinary systems development, serial production implementation, and long lifecycle management within certified/safety-critical environments.
• Fluency in French and English is a must.
• Key Technical Skills:
• Expertise in system engineering with a holistic approach.
• Proficiency in mechatronic architectures, embedded electronics design, real-time software/middleware/communication frameworks.
• Deep understanding of trade-offs between performance vs. cost, sophistication vs. robustness, and innovation vs. industrialization.
• Leadership Qualities:
• Strategic technical leadership with decision-making authority.
• Ability to standardize processes and confidently say "no" when necessary.
• Comfortable navigating constrained industrial environments with exposure to demanding clients like armed forces.
• Credibility among senior engineers, program managers, and high-level technology partners.
